stem.text:
The pH of a person's blood can be found using the formula

\[ \mathrm{pH}=6.1+\log \left(\frac{B}{C}\right) \]

where \(B\) represents the concentration of bicarbonate in the blood, in mEq/L

\(C\) represents the concentration of carbonic acid in the blood, in \(\mathrm{mEq} / \mathrm{L}\)

Kansas has a blood pH of 7.41. In her blood sample, the concentration of carbonic acid is \(1.41 \mathrm{mEq} / \mathrm{L}\).

Determine the concentration of bicarbonate in her blood.

Express the answer correct to one decimal place.

Vitaly was asked to solve the exponential equation \(5^{2 x+7}=3 \cdot 7^{x}\).

Vitaly's work:

\[ \begin{aligned} \log \left(5^{2 x+7}\right)  =\log \left(3 \cdot 7^{x}\right) \\ (2 x+7) \log 5  =\log \left(21^{x}\right) \\ 2 x \log 5+7 \log 5  =x \log 21 \\ 7 \log 5  =x \log 21-2 x \log 5 \\ 7 \log 5  =x(\log 21-2 \log 5) \\ x  =\frac{7 \log 5}{\log 21-2 \log 5} \end{aligned} \]

stem.text: Justify that \(f(x)=3 x+2\) and \(g(x)=\frac{x-3}{2}\) are not inverses of each other.

extensions.latexSource: Justify that \(f(x)=3 x+2\) and \(g(x)=\frac{x-3}{2}\) are not inverses of each other.

solution.text:
Method 1

Let \(y=f(x)\)

\[ y=3 x+2 \]

Let \(y=f^{-1}(x)\)

\[ \begin{array}{ll} x=3 y+2  1 \text { mark for switching } x \text { and } y \\ \frac{x-2}{3}=y  \\ \frac{x-2}{3}=f^{-1}(x)  1 \text { mark for justification } \\ g(x) \neq f^{-1}(x)  \end{array} \]

2 marks

Method 2

If they are inverses, then \(g(f(x))=x\), and \(f(g(x))=x\).

\[ \begin{aligned} g(3 x+2)  =\frac{3 x+2-3}{2} \\  =\frac{3 x-1}{2} \end{aligned} \]

1 mark for \(g(f(x))\) or \(f(g(x))\)

Since \(g(f(x)) \neq x\), they are not inverses of each other.

1 mark for justification

2 marks
